fusions.name: Snagged Thread
fusions.desc: A leaping strike at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 6 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Through the Weave
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Into the Folds
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Padded Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
